description: This file defines the `absl::bind_front()` function, a utility for binding arguments to functions or functors, serving as a replacement for `std::bind()` and intended as a drop-in for C++20's `std::bind_front()`. It includes documentation, conditional inclusion of `<functional>`, and a template implementation for environments lacking `std::bind_front`.

methods.name: bind_front
methods.description: Template function that creates a bind_front_t object, binding arguments to a function or functor, used when the standard library does not provide `std::bind_front`.
